name: HEG Advanced Materials Ltd
title: HEG Advanced Materials Ltd - 509631 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Graphite electrode maker at >90% utilisation with H2 price hikes planned, but Q4 volumes fell ~1,000 t and FY27 H1 EBITDA guided only ~17–20% versus 22% prior.

utilisation.quote: If you strictly talk about capacity utilization on production, actually it’s 95% for the quarter.

capex.peers_comment: Management said no peer has announced any electrode capacity addition; HEG is expanding 80k→100k t and to 115k t by early 2028.
capex.quote: excep t our expansion, there is nobody who has even announced anything as yet.

triggers.label: Production utilisation ~95% in Q4
triggers.quote: If you strictly talk about capacity utilization on production, actually it’s 95% for the quarter.

triggers.label: Price hikes planned for H2 on uncommitted volumes
triggers.quote: definitely towards H2, our aim is to have price increase, not only to protect our margins, but to help improve further.

triggers.label: No peer electrode capacity announced
triggers.quote: excep t our expansion, there is nobody who has even announced anything as yet.

triggers.label: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~17–18%, not 22%
triggers.quote: these two quarters where we have committed volumes maybe around 17-18 or something.

guidance.quote: the EBITDA range will be the 20% we can say for the next 1st Quarter and to 2nd Quarter.

guidance.metric: Price increase on unbooked orders in H2
guidance.quote: definitely towards H2, our aim is to have price increase
we have already announced our next expansion to 115,000 tons, which is likely to be operational by earl y 2028.

prior_guidance_check.metric: EBITDA margin ~22% sustained for next couple of quarters
prior_guidance_check.quote: Then in Q4, because of all these Middle East crisis, we could not sustain that kind of margin.

red_flags.label: Q4 loss from GrafTech mark-to-market and FX
red_flags.quote: We reported a loss of INR 189 crores. This is mainly attributable to fair values and impact on foreign investment

red_flags.label: Q4 sales volume down ~1,000 t; low-price mix
red_flags.quote: there is a slightly less volume to the tune of, I guess, about 1000 tons and some depression in price

red_flags.label: Investment in GrafTech thesis dependent on needle coke
red_flags.quote: it went down by 30%-40%. It has recovered a lot in the last 2-3 months.

evasions.topic: Rupee benefit net of dollar costs
evasions.quote: We can take it offline. We don’t want to talk about specifics numbers.
How much will be the quantum, whether it will be 300, 400, 500 is very difficult to say at this stage.

evasions.topic: Chinese UHP export share vs peers
evasions.quote: So, they have to explain to their stakeholders why they are at this.
